literal: Ignorance will-cause loss fate; knowledge will-expand prospering fate reached time.
translation: The fate that brings loss will cause a person to become ignorant. The fate that brings prosperity, when it arrives, will expand their knowledge.
modern: அழிவைத் தரும் ஊழ்வினை வரும்போது அது ஒருவனை அறிவற்றவனாக்குகிறது; ஆக்கத்தைத் தரும் ஊழ்வினை வரும்போது அது அவனது அறிவை விரிவடையச் செய்கிறது.
explanation: This couplet explains how destiny directly influences human intellect and decision-making. The fate of loss clouds a person's judgment, causing them to act foolishly and bring about their own ruin. Conversely, when the fate of prosperity arrives, it expands their wisdom, guiding them naturally toward success. The word 'அகற்றும்' typically means 'removes' or 'dispels', but in this specific context, it takes the sense of 'widens' or 'expands' to contrast with the ignorance caused by bad fate.
